categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: high-end equipment manufacturing and energy & energy services. The equipment manufacturing segment focuses on centrifugal compressors, industrial gas turbines, and related complete sets of equipment for industries such as petrochemical, coal chemical, natural gas chemical, green energy, and energy storage. The energy services segment includes oil and gas exploration software development, oilfield technical services, and oilfield asset management, with operations in domestic and international markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced industrial turbine technology, proprietary aerodynamic design of centrifugal compressors, and modular design for industrial gas turbines. Manufacturing adheres to international standards such as API617 and ASME, with capabilities including a 50MW compressor-turbine joint test center. The company emphasizes green manufacturing, digital and intelligent production methods, and provides full lifecycle services including installation, maintenance, and technical consulting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic petrochemical and fertilizer producers, international energy and chemical companies, and oilfield service enterprises. The company serves industries such as synthetic ammonia, urea, methanol, chlor-alkali, green hydrogen, and energy storage. It has a strong presence in domestic markets and expanding footprint in Belt and Road countries, Middle East, Central Asia, and emerging agricultural nations.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span China with headquarters in Beijing and manufacturing bases in Liaoning, Hebei, and other provinces. Internationally, the company has subsidiaries and projects in the United States, Canada, Trinidad and Tobago, Kazakhstan, the United Arab Emirates, and Hong Kong. It actively pursues global market expansion, especially in emerging markets along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy and chemical supply chain. It manufactures critical high-end equipment used in production facilities and provides integrated energy services including exploration software, engineering, and oilfield operations. It also offers aftermarket services and maintenance, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the energy equipment and services value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-end, green, and intelligent equipment manufacturing, expanding green energy technologies such as green hydrogen and ammonia, and enhancing global market penetration. The company invests in R&D through a dedicated turbine research institute with multiple labs, focusing on turbine technology upgrades, green energy solutions, intelligent control systems, and manufacturing innovation. It also develops integrated oil and gas exploration software platforms and pursues digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of equipment and spare parts, oil and gas extraction and sales, technical services including software sales and consulting, and engineering contracting (EPC). The company also earns income from investment dividends and licensing. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic high-end equipment manufacturer with technology and market share comparable to international first-tier competitors in centrifugal compressors and industrial turbines. It holds a strong reputation in the synthetic ammonia and petrochemical equipment sectors and is recognized for its green manufacturing and service capabilities. It competes with global and domestic manufacturers in energy equipment and oilfield service markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 552 million, a 15.91% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 165.78 million, slightly improved from the prior year. Despite revenue decline due to project delays, gross margin improved due to cost control and higher value-added product mix. The company’s total assets grew by 14.14% to about RMB 2.21 billion. Cash flow from operations turned positive with a 339.97% increase, reflecting improved order backlog and collection efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, energy efficiency, and long service life (minimum 20 years) of its equipment, supported by rigorous design, manufacturing, and testing standards. It offers highly customized solutions and comprehensive lifecycle services tailored to client needs. Its green manufacturing practices and pioneering green energy equipment (e.g., green hydrogen compressors) differentiate it in the market. Strong R&D capabilities and integrated software and service offerings provide competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets.
